query:
SELECT hs.id, hs.rfqId, hs.chain, hs.status, hs.htlcAddress, hs.locktime, hs.claimTxId, hs.claimedAt, hs.createdAt,
       FROM_UNIXTIME(hs.locktime) as locktime_human,
       CASE WHEN hs.locktime < UNIX_TIMESTAMP() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END as timelock_state,
       rt.status as trade_status, rt.settledAt, rt.solClaimTx
FROM htlc_swaps hs
LEFT JOIN rfq_trades rt ON rt.id = hs.rfqId
WHERE hs.status = 'pending' AND hs.chain = 'solana'
ORDER BY hs.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
